transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Before I issue today's vehicle assignments and dispatch board, let's conduct our transport-board huddle. I need the transportation, medical, signal, and engineer representatives to report any load or vehicle-control requirements for today's four moves: clinic cold-storage cases to the medical annex, communications mast to the north relay point, generator to the engineering yard, and routine administrative pallets to the headquarters warehouse. Please share any constraints so I can match the right vehicle — RV-2 refrigerated van, F-7 flatbed, T-5 5-ton, or T-2 2.5-ton — to each move.
